title: Prompt Relay: Inference-Time Temporal Control for Video
summary: A training-free inference method that enables precise chronological control in video generation by routing prompts to specific time segments. It suppresses semantic leakage between events by applying distance-based penalties to the cross-attention mechanism.
research_notes: Effectively solves temporal entanglement in diffusion-based video models without requiring additional training or fine-tuning.

evolution.summary: Originally a research implementation, Prompt-Relay has become a standard utility integrated into the Wan 2.2 and LTX 2.3 ecosystems. It is now a core component of the LTX Director timeline editor and various ComfyUI nodes for multi-event storytelling.
